title: France on edge: Thousands on streets as weekend of protests begin; 70k cops deployed

Inspired by encouraging words from coaches Gautam Gambhir and Sitanshu Kotak, he anchored the innings in a tense chase, with Nitish Kumar Reddy supporting him with a vital 26 runs. Despite an absence of a suspect, the insurance company rejected their claims, citing potential arson and insufficient cooperation. Now, an appeals court has enabled the couple's lawsuit to proceed, revealing unresolved issues concerning compliance with insurance policies and the expectation of good faith actions.

title: New York court revives privacy claim over cameras filming family's backyard

title: Idaho's closed horse track reopens as $42m public park with restored wetlands
content: In a remarkable redevelopment initiative, Garden City, Idaho, has repurposed the old Les Bois horse-racing track into a vibrant public park, spanning nearly 50 acres. Known as the Park at Expo Idaho, it features diverse landscapes including wetlands and nature trails, alongside recreational facilities like a newly designed skate park. This transformation promotes outdoor activities and ecological restoration while already drawing in local wildlife.

title: Michael and Susan Dell’s foundation spotlights free skills training in Texas
content: The Michael & Susan Dell Foundation has reported remarkable achievements among graduates of its skilled-trades training initiatives. Over a dedicated five-week course crafted with input from employers, participants secure jobs almost immediately. Success stories like Mariah showcase a transition into well-paying, stable careers, while Skillpoint Alliance is enhancing training capacities to address Texas's rising need for skilled workers, ultimately promoting economic growth and assisting businesses in meeting workforce challenges.

title: Iowa launches $4.9m project to reclaim 150 acres of abandoned coal mines
content: The Iowa Department of Agriculture has launched a reclamation initiative targeting environmental challenges posed by abandoned coal mines. Covering approximately 150 acres in Mahaska and Marion counties, the project aims to revitalize water quality and enhance soil health in these areas. Past reclamation successes have notably improved local ecosystems, showcasing a dedicated effort to rehabilitate devastated landscapes for sustainable future use.

title: US on alert as Iran's plan to target Americans abroad in 'advanced stages': Report

This step follows alarming threats from Iran towards U.S. personnel and Houthi assaults on Saudi territory, prompting the evacuation of non-essential personnel and their families from Saudi Arabia.

title: Abhishek makes history, reaches six-hitting milestone no batter has touched before
content: Abhishek reached the milestone with a six over extra cover off Matt Henry in the third over of India's chase. He had gone past former India captain Rohit Sharma, who hit 98 powerplay sixes in his T20I career, in the series opener on Thursday.

title: Jason Kelce breaks silence on Eagles coaching role amid O-line crisis
content: Jason Kelce has addressed speculation about a potential Philadelphia Eagles coaching role as the team battles injuries and inconsistent offensive line performances. The former center said he occasionally helps players but cited his packed schedule and the availability of more experienced coaches. With commitments to ESPN’s Monday Night Countdown, the New Heights podcast, and his family, Kelce appears focused on retirement rather than returning to the NFL coaching ranks.

title: Inside Peyton Manning's $5M, 17,000 sq ft mansion in Colorado
content: Peyton Manning lives in Cherry Hills Village mansion near Denver. The mansion boasts an exclusive game room, a rich study room, and a private balcony with its own outdoor kitchen. The gated residence is surrounded by lush greenery and offers a picturesque landscape during flowering seasons. The massive home has shades of beige, white, red, and wood-colored interiors.

title: Seat ambitions could trip pre-poll alliance talks in Goa
content: As the 2027 assembly elections approach, political parties in Goa are diligently attempting to forge pre-poll alliances, but conflicts abound. The BJP and MGP face tough talks over seat sharing, with MGP pushing for a larger stake. Meanwhile, the opposition, including Congress, GFP, RG, and AAP, grapples with internal divisions and has yet to agree on a unified strategy.

title: Tiger Shroff sells Mumbai apartment for Rs 9cr days after firing incident

Earlier this year, he also offloaded a Pune property for Rs 8.87 crore. Read on

title: Asian Para Games 2026 conclude in Nagoya: India sign off with record 114 medals
content: India's performance at the Aichi-Nagoya 2026 Asian Para Games was nothing short of spectacular, achieving a historic milestone with 114 medals - 30 gold, 35 silver, and 49 bronze. They finished in fourth overall, with para athletics as the standout discipline, contributing 65 medals. Hosted by Japan, the event brought together around 4,000 athletes from 45 nations. The next games are scheduled for Doha, Qatar, in 2030.

title: Ludhiana: Assailants chop off man’s hand, hand severed limb to shopkeeper

His friend was also injured during the incident which occurred in the Daba area. The police believe that this violent act resulted from personal enmity between individuals.

title: UAE's Ras Al-Khaimah shuts all beaches; oil spill triggers closures across coastline
content: Ras Al Khaimah has ordered the closure of all beaches following an oil spill within the emirate. The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment has confirmed the spill was detected from a tanker, affecting marine life. Authorities are conducting containment and cleanup operations in coordination with local and federal agencies. Residents in adjacent emirates have reported odours, although no health risks have been confirmed.

title: Tilak, Nitish rescue India from 112/6 to seal thrilling 4-wicket win vs New Zealand
content: In a thrilling second T20I, Tilak Varma and Nitish Kumar Reddy showcased their prowess, steering India to a nail-biting victory against New Zealand. Chasing a formidable target of 181, India found themselves in trouble at 112/6. However, Varma's explosive unbeaten 51 off just 26 balls proved crucial, leading the team to triumph in 19.5 overs, despite New Zealand's strong bowling performance from Mitchell Santner, who claimed four wickets.

title: Mystery surrounds death of Class 12 student found burnt behind Delhi school
content: An 18-year-old girl was discovered burnt behind the guard room of a school in Krishna Nagar. Police received a call regarding the fire incident and promptly arrived at the scene. They conducted preliminary proceedings and collected materials from the spot, including the victim's school bag. A crime team thoroughly inspected the location to gather evidence for the ongoing investigation.

title: Arshdeep Singh scripts history, breaks Bhuvneshwar’s record to set new India mark
content: Arshdeep Singh achieved a significant milestone by becoming India's leading wicket-taker in T20Is in a calendar year, taking his tally to 38 wickets in 2026 to surpass Bhuvneshwar Kumar's previous record of 37. In the second T20I against New Zealand, Arshdeep dismissed Tim Seifert early and later claimed the crucial wicket of Glenn Phillips. Despite India's struggles during the chase, Tilak Varma's unbeaten 51 kept the visitors in contention. Arshdeep's consistent performances further underline his importance to India's bowling attack in the shortest format.

title: AI may flag H-1B visa filings discrepancies as US immigration checks get more stringent
content: US immigration authorities are set to intensify their review of H-1B visa records by utilizing artificial intelligence technology. This will allow them to detect any mismatches between the addresses reported and the actual worksite locations. Both employers and employees must diligently maintain accurate and consistent immigration documents, alerting agencies to any address modifications. As AI further develops, keeping immigration filings exact will be increasingly important for H-1B visa professionals.

title: Australian reporter rescues driver moments before SUV sinks in floodwaters
content: Will Murray, an ABC reporter, was covering heavy rain and flooding in Morayfield when a four-wheel drive got submerged. As the driver began to sink, Murray swiftly called for emergency services and then jumped in to help. Joined by bystander Daniel Hainey, they managed to open the door and free the driver from the vehicle. Emergency services arrived shortly after the rescue, emphasizing the dangers of floodwaters.

title: 1 dead after massive fire in Noida's Sector 126; several shops engulfed

title: Marshall Faulk’s Parkinson’s journey: How the NFL legend found a new purpose

He emphasizes the importance of early medical intervention, encouraging others to act swiftly if they experience alarming symptoms. Currently, Faulk balances coaching college football while managing his health, highlighting that early detection can greatly enhance quality of life.

New Zealand set a formidable target of 181 runs, and Sooryavanshi's early dismissal hindered India's chase of 180/5.
